links.outcome: Ground truth via cardiologist consensus panels annotating sampled events
links.effect: Random sample of 5,235 rhythm events, including 2,236 critical arrhythmias, was annotated by one of 17 cardiologist consensus panels to compare AI and technicians.
links.quote: To compare the performance of the AI model and the technicians, a random sample of 5,235 rhythm events identified by the AI model or by technicians, of which 2,236 events were identified as critical arrhythmias, was selected for annotation by one of 17 cardiologist consensus panels.

unlisted_practices: AI-only direct-to-physician reporting without technician review

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI algorithm (DeepRhythmAI) compared to human technicians for ambulatory ECG interpretation against cardiologist consensus, exploring direct-to-physician reporting feasibility, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
